dedupe_keys.name: census business and industry reports in common long format

description: This Kaggle package reformats sixteen United States Census economic reports into a common long-format CSV with separate metadata and notes. Its series cover construction spending, housing, manufacturing orders and inventories, trade, retail activity and several quarterly financial reports. Series identifiers join values to definitions and units. Coverage is United States reporting, sometimes by state, at monthly, quarterly or annual frequency; exact endpoints vary and were not inspected. Access is free under the registry CC0 declaration. A limitation is that over one third of the series hold error estimates, not measured quantities, and full date strings denote period starts, not daily observations. Simulation uses include preparing historical construction, production and freight-demand covariates. It overlaps named components in CENSUS_GAPS.md, including construction spending and residential construction, but that list does not identify this combined reformatted package. It complements data-eia-petroleum-supply-and-prices with economic context. No numerical files or linked preparation script were executed.
